visualScope: London Victoria Memorial with the paired curved pools and stair flights, four bronze lion groups, seated queen, allegorical figures and gilded Winged Victory.
limitations: Sculpture anatomy, carved details and minor fountain fittings are medium-fi interpretations of the exterior photographs. Water in the pools is represented by static surfaces.
The outline, basin polygons, statue points and The Mall supply the main layout. Steps and elevations follow standard terrain and visual proportions.
